faq.q: Can I get a government IT job without GATE?
faq.a: Yes. NIC, SSC JE (IT), UPSC IES (for engineers) don't require GATE. PSUs like BEL, HAL, BHEL prefer GATE but some have own exams.

faq.q: What is the salary for government IT jobs?
faq.a: Scientist-B (ISRO/DRDO): ~₹56,100 (Level 10). Probationary Engineer (BEL): ~₹40,000-50,000. NIC Scientist: ~₹56,100. Plus DA, HRA, allowances.

faq.q: Is coding required for government IT jobs?
faq.a: For developer roles (NIC, ISRO), yes. For system admin/network roles, less coding but strong fundamentals. DEO roles require typing, not coding.

faq.q: How competitive are government IT jobs?
faq.a: ISRO: 1-2 lakh applicants for 300-500 vacancies. NIC: 50,000+ for 500-1000. BEL/HAL: 1-2 lakh for 100-300. Very competitive.

faq.q: What qualifications are needed for government IT jobs?
faq.a: B.Tech/MCA for scientist/engineer roles. Diploma/ITI for technician roles. 12th pass for DEO. Some PSUs accept M.Sc (Computer Science).

faq.q: Where do I find official IT job notifications?
faq.a: nic.in, isro.gov.in, drdo.gov.in, bel-india.in, hal-india.co.in, bhel.com. SarkariJobs+ links the official notification on every listing.
